claims.statement: If U is a top-three absolute-eigenvalue frame of A, s_3(A)>=L, p_i=||U_i||^2 and C=A[-i,-i], then s_3(C)>=(1-p_i)L-s_4(A). Hence s_3(C)<theta L forces s_4(A)>(1-p_i-theta)L.

If p_i<=mu and 0<theta<1-mu, then the same physical deletion is either paid by the account04/B08 child-window theorem, yields a child localized row witness >theta L/512, or its third-child spectral loss forces a rank-four parent spill at delta=(1-mu-theta)L which is paid by the global ridge-window theorem or yields a parent localized row witness >delta L/512.

At mu=1/48 and theta=1/64, child spectral loss s_3(C)<L/64 forces s_4(A)>185L/192 and therefore either ||p_Q||_infinity<65.658/L with p_Q continuous C_0, or an original coordinate has max(|A_kk|,||A[k,-k]||_2)>185L/98304.

designated_partner.application: At theta=1/64, if the deletion child has s_3(C)>=L/64 and its |lambda|>=L/4096 window has maximum coordinate leverage <=1/32, then ||p_Q||_infinity<4096/L and p_Q is continuous C_0.
